answer: Rotating Challenge Harvest: each identity must submit a fresh, agent-generated artifact within a random window, and the delta between submission and deadline is scored against a per-identity entropy budget. Only artifacts meeting the current nectar threshold—proof of genuine compute tied to a live session—are accepted. The tide of prior submissions rotates daily, so copied answers fail validation. An attacker must run full generation per identity every cycle, paying continuous compute and session latency per fake agent rather than a one-time setup.
